audit.method: Source-free static and metadata audit of copied code, result, manifest, and pre-existing provenance evidence.

access.parsed_material: Code, JSON result/manifest, README, and pre-existing provenance result/manifest files only

binding_limitations: The result does not contain the screen-code SHA-256; this independent receipt roots code, result, and manifest together.
There is no frozen experiment protocol, target source lock, or run log in this package. The result seal proves self-integrity, not preregistration or execution authenticity.
The public-reference manifest binds declared ranges and hashes, but this restricted audit did not reopen the 100 MiB tensor payloads.

reference.scope_note: The audit authenticates the copied manifest and its internal consistency; it did not redownload or open the four tensor payloads.

formula_audit.implemented_family: For each target neuron and each role, center target/reference rows, fit an independent affine scalar regression, sum explained SSE across Up/Down, then solve a rectangular one-to-one assignment from 768 target neurons into 6144 reference neurons.

regression.numerical_caveat: The CuPy dot products are accumulated by FP32 GEMM before FP64 division. Centering subtracts an FP32-rounded mean, while the hashed beta uses the FP64 mean; therefore the README's literal exact-FP64 wording is too strong.

controls.construction: Two deterministic signed coordinate scrambles for each of two reference layers.
controls.caveat: Up and Down are scrambled independently, so target cross-role coordinate structure is not preserved. The uncorrected source result is already 28.4 times short of the requirement.

verdict.reason: Even the free-reference, free-layer-selection, free-assignment, and free-coefficient raw screen supplies only 3.52% of the required capture; control-corrected signal supplies 0.087%.
verdict.claim_boundary: This does not reject unsearched dense layers, nonlinear or multi-neuron references, private pretraining ancestors, or other training lineages. It supports deprioritizing this specific public two-layer affine neuron-ancestor path.

seal.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false, after removing seal.canonical_unsigned_sha256
